products.name: Lilikoi Mineral Defense Sport Sunscreen SPF 30
products.tagline: Easy-to-apply, non-greasy, water-resistant SPF 30 mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide. Stays on when swimming or sweating, lightweight finish.
products.description: An easy-to-apply sport formulation for face and body, this SPF 30 mineral filter sunscreen is non-greasy and water-resistant up to 40 minutes. Highly effective for outdoor activities like swimming and high-performance sports where perspiration can impact standard sunscreen efficacy, this zinc oxide sunscreen protects from head to toe.
products.howToUse: Apply a liberal layer over the face and body 15 minutes before sun exposure and leave on. Reapply at least every 2 hours. Reapply after 40 minutes of swimming or sweating and immediately after towel drying.

ingredients.name: Zinc Oxide

ingredients.note: contains Vitamin C and antioxidants which help with the visible signs of aging
